name: Fujimiya Ryuuichi
source:
The protagonist of the main story. He is the heir to the large “Date General Hospital” and, at first glance, appears to be a calm and rational young doctor.

As part of his father’s “plan,” he is entrusted with a small hospital, where he ends up using the nurses he personally selected as “comfort nurses”.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/9184/?gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
